MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The adhesive hook-and-loop strips fit my recent interest in fastening and mounting: I would use them for lightweight attachments that I may want to remove later.",
    "Super glue fits small repair needs alongside my screws and anchors, although the ten-tube pack exceeds what I need now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Test leads and ring terminals require an electrical project I have not shown a need for; buying construction fasteners does not make wiring supplies useful to me.",
    "Medicine cups do not establish a need for diagnostic tests, baby wipes, or exam gloves. Those purchases serve different purposes.",
    "The calipers and pegboard locks depend on specific tasks or equipment I have not indicated, while twelve wastebaskets and a thousand small gloves require quantities or fit I cannot justify."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat tools and maintenance supplies as interchangeable, when I choose them for particular fastening or repair jobs.",
    "My purchases of bulk nails and screws seem to have been extended to unrelated bulk supplies, even though quantity only makes sense when I expect to use the item."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated nail, screw, and anchor purchases point toward practical fastening needs; an alternative attachment method is more relevant than an unrelated workshop accessory.",
    "Compatibility matters: nail angle, screw dimensions, vacuum-bag type, glove size, and terminal gauge determine whether something is usable, not just broadly related.",
    "An occasional medicine-cup or vacuum-bag purchase reflects a specific supply need, rather than an ongoing need for other medical or cleaning products."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my repair and fastening needs but stretched isolated purchases into unrelated supplies and unsupported project assumptions."
}
